subject: Mythology
title: Freya: Goddess of Love and War
description: A short lesson to help you apply Freya: Goddess of Love and War.

hook.text: Freya was the most beautiful goddess in all the nine worlds, and she wept tears of pure gold.

buildup.text: She ruled over love, beauty, and fertility, but she was also a fierce warrior goddess of the Vanir.

discovery.text: She chose half of all battle-slain warriors for her own hall, Folkvangr, before Odin took the rest.

twist.text: Giants constantly tried to kidnap her. Many myths revolve around the gods protecting Freya from them.

climax.text: She taught Odin the magic of seidr, giving the king of the gods a power he did not originally possess.

punchline.text: The goddess of love was also the one who taught war gods magic.

quiz.question: What unique power did Freya teach to Odin?
options: The ability to shapeshift into animals
The secret of forging unbreakable weapons
